name: openpixo/pixel-8-bit
title: Retro pixel · 8-bit
description: The strict tier of the retro pixel family: four colors per sprite, chunky clusters and early-console charm, down to two-tone 1-bit art.

description_i18n.en: The strict tier of the retro pixel family: four colors per sprite, chunky clusters and early-console charm, down to two-tone 1-bit art.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 复古像素家族中最严格的一档：每个精灵四色、紧凑像素块和早期主机韵味，也可进一步收紧为双色 1 位画面。

examples.title: Tiny adventurer
examples.prompt: Generate a 16x16 adventurer idle sprite using the pixel-8-bit art style. Give the character a blue cap and a lantern, use at most four colors, and export the native transparent sprite plus an enlarged preview.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 pixel-8-bit 美术风格生成一张 16x16 冒险家待机精灵。角色戴蓝帽、提灯笼，最多使用四种颜色，导出原生透明精灵和放大预览。

examples.title: Dungeon tile family
examples.prompt: Create a matching 16x16 dungeon tile family using the pixel-8-bit art style: stone floor, solid wall, doorway and stair entrance. Keep colors limited and edges ready for grid placement.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 pixel-8-bit 美术风格制作一组配套的 16x16 地牢地块：石地板、实心墙、门洞和楼梯入口。限制色数，确保边缘适合网格拼接。

examples.title: Two-tone 1-bit raven
examples.prompt: Generate a 32x32 raven companion sprite using the pixel-8-bit art style in strict 1-bit mode: use only #14243A and #F2E7BA with no intermediate tones, sparse ordered hatching for feathers and an open silhouette around the beak and feet.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 pixel-8-bit 美术风格的严格 1 位模式生成一张 32x32 乌鸦伙伴精灵：只使用 #14243A 和 #F2E7BA 两色，不要中间色；羽毛用稀疏的有序排线表现，喙和脚周围保留开放的负空间。

style.prompt: Early 8-bit console pixel art built from bold square-pixel clusters. Use no more than four visible colors per sprite, including its darkest contour, drawn from the shared palette. Compact silhouettes, flat color regions, sparse single-pixel highlights and clean tile-friendly geometry. Prefer readable shape changes over extra shading; use nearest-neighbor scaling.
style.negativePrompt: photorealism, anti-aliasing, soft shadows, gradients, high-color shading, fine texture, painterly strokes, mixed pixel sizes, glossy 3D rendering, text, watermark

constraints.outline: Single native-pixel contour with no soft edge.
